title: Compliance Needs Concierge and Evidence Autopilot for Enterprise Requests
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: Large enterprise customers frequently submit multi-part compliance requests (SOC2/ISO attestations, GDPR/DPA questions, HIPAA scoping, and long vendor questionnaires). The current intake is manual: PMs route PDFs or spreadsheets to security/solutions leads, and engineering pulls artifacts from multiple systems. This creates long TTRs, inconsistent prioritization, and duplicated evidence collection.

Goal: Build a lightweight "Compliance Concierge" workflow in the Console intake that automatically classifies incoming compliance requests, assigns a priority tier, and populates an evidence collection checklist (Evidence Autopilot) with links to candidate artifacts, owners, and estimated delivery time. The feature should reduce manual triage time, accelerate responses to high-value enterprise deals, and create an audit trail for recurring questions.

Scope (MVP):
- Intake form endpoint in Console to upload questionnaires or reference links (no UI redesign beyond a modal).
- Automated classifier that maps questions to a canonical requirement taxonomy (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, DPA items, and vendor questionnaire categories).
- Rule-driven prioritization that outputs a triage tier (Urgent / High / Normal) based on deal stage, data scope, and regs implicated.
- Evidence Autopilot: suggests 3 candidate artifacts per requirement (policy docs, architecture diagrams, controls) with owner and link.
- Generate a one-click export bundle (zip or shareable link) with selected artifacts and a simple cover note for customers.

Out of scope for MVP: full UI redesign, automated artifact redaction, on-prem evidence retrieval, legal-approved final responses.

Acceptance criteria: 
1) Classifier achieves >= 85% precision on mapping common SOC2/GDPR questions in our test set (50 sampled enterprise questionnaires).
2) Evidence Autopilot returns at least one relevant artifact for 80% of mapped items in the test set.
3) Triage stage reduces average first-response time from intake to initial reply by 40% for pilot customers.
4) Audit log entries are created for each intake with timestamp, classifier result, suggested artifacts, and assigned owners.

Proposed approach and tradeoffs: 
- Use a hybrid classifier: a lightweight LLM-based semantic matcher for free-text items combined with rules and regex for structured question IDs. Tradeoff: faster setup vs. needing model monitoring for drift.
- Leverage existing knowledge graph of internal artifacts (Confluence + Drive + S3 index) rather than building a new store. Tradeoff: may surface stale artifacts; we must include freshness score and owner verification step.
- Prioritization rules should be transparent and editable by PM/Security leads (avoid opaque ML-only decisions).

Rollout plan: 
- Week 0-2: Build intake endpoint and sample classifier; index 5 key artifact sources.
- Week 3-4: Pilot with 3 enterprise customers (Security and Solutions shepherded).
- Week 5: Iterate on classifier thresholds and evidence ranking based on pilot feedback.
- Week 6-8: Add export bundle and audit logging; prepare runbook for Security/Legal.

Metrics to track: 
- Time-to-first-response after intake (target -40% for pilot).
- Precision/recall of mapping vs. human baseline.
- Artifact match rate and owner confirmation rate.
- Customer satisfaction (CSAT) for compliance responses.

Open questions: 
- Which artifact sources do we index initially (Confluence spaces, Drive folders, S3 buckets)? Recommended: Confluence security KB + shared Drive compliance folder + runtime architecture diagrams.
- Should evidence suggestions require owner approval before being sent to customers, or allow PM opt-out? Recommend owner verification step for P0/P1 items.
- How to surface redaction flags for artifact content (PII/security-sensitive)? MVP will flag but not redact.

Stakeholders: 
- Product: Aisha Kapoor (PM), Liam Ortega (PM lead)
- Security & Compliance: Nadia Gomez (Security), Marcus Li (Privacy)
- Engineering: Runtime/Infra leads for artifact index (ENG-20488), Backend connectors (ENG-21002)
- Solutions Engineering: Priya Singh (customer pilot)

Risks and mitigation: 
- False positives/irrelevant artifacts => mitigation: owner verification workflow and feedback loop to classifier.
- Sensitive data leakage => mitigation: restrict which folders are indexed, and surface redaction flag for Security review.
- Legal/regulatory nuance misclassification => mitigation: keep manual review on final outbound bundle for P0/P1 customers.

Next steps: 
1) Align with Security on allowed artifact sources and initial rule set (owner: Nadia Gomez).
2) Engineering spike to validate indexing (owner: ENG-20488).
3) Assemble pilot customers and prepare intake templates (owner: Priya Singh).
